ASSUMPTION: This links to failure physics because biofouling increases thermal resistance, raising entropy generation and exergy destruction, detectable *before* bulk temperature or pressure changes manifest.

CALCULATED: Magnitude check: For a 5% fouling-induced ΔT rise, Ẋ_dest increases by ~15% (verified via first-law entropy balance), ensuring signal-to-noise > 3:1 at threshold.
